connector.name: Spark SQL
connector.registryDescription: Query Spark SQL clusters via Thrift/HiveServer2. Works with Spark, EMR, Hive, Impala.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package spark-sql-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aidancorrell account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SPARK_HOST

env.name: SPARK_PORT
env.description: Port of the Spark Thrift Server (default: 10000)

env.name: SPARK_AUTH
env.description: Authentication method: NONE, LDAP, KERBEROS, CUSTOM, or NOSASL
